name: Tej
description: Honey fermented with gesho twigs into a cloudy sweet-bitter wine.

ayurveda.note: Madhu and madya are both ushna.

histamine.note: Fermented honey — alcohol plus a live ferment.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. A glass of the honey wine, sweet enough to disguise its strength, still delivers enough to produce it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
